root_causes.description: Quote is shipping's only downstream, and the shipping↔quote client span is delayed while quote's own server span is fast — consistent with a network/edge latency fault affecting the quote call path rather than quote compute.

evidence.observed_value: p99=1.98 ms (no anomaly) — server processing healthy

remediation_steps: Inspect/restart the shipping service pods to clear any injected network delay or connection hang on the shipping→quote egress path (no crash/OOM events observed).
Check Chaos Mesh tc netem or flagd feature-flag latency injection targeting shipping (or the shipping↔quote edge) and disable it.
Verify network policy/DNS/connection-pool health between shipping and quote; the client span is slow while quote's server span is 1.98ms.
Confirm checkout and frontend latency recover once shipping latency normalizes (they are downstream propagation only).
Add an alert on shipping SERVER/CLIENT p99 latency (>50ms) to catch tail latency before the global P99 watchdog fires.
